segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling customer care. My name is Aarav. How may I help you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I have been waiting for my order and nobody has explained the delay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry about the delay. May I confirm your order reference?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It is O R D two zero four eight.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. The dispatch was delayed, but it is now scheduled for tomorrow. I will send the update by S M S.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That answers my question. Thank you.
